name: Sajókaza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sajókaza: a blue oval shield with a grapevine, with a helm, a crest and blue and yellow mantling, above a blue scroll inscribed SAJÓKAZA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sajókaza arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
